stem: Dry-room RH spikes briefly when the door opens, then returns to the normal range. How should this differ from a sustained multi-hour excursion?
choices: A brief transient should be interpreted in context, while a sustained excursion requires stronger follow-up or escalation
Both always require discarding the lot
Both prove the sensor is broken
rationale: Environmental interpretation should distinguish short operational transients from sustained process deviations.
